products.text:
Type: three-drawer chest of drawers
Use: storing clothes and linens; bedroom, living room
Style: contemporary, mid-century modern, glam
Materials: white lacquered wood with carved honeycomb relief fronts, brass-finish pulls and legs
Colors: white, warm gold
Shape: rectangular case, three wide drawers with textured hexagon pattern, curved recessed brass pulls, four slim tapered gold legs, raised and fairly light, medium size
Feel: bright, elegant, textured
Goes with: white or pale walls, brass accents, light wood; modern, glam or mid-century bedrooms

Type: wall-mounted storage cabinet
Use: storing and displaying small items; living room, home office, entryway
Style: farmhouse, rustic
Materials: distressed natural wood planks, black metal handles
Colors: warm medium brown wood, black
Shape: shallow wall box, three open cubbies on top, two barn doors with X-brace planks below, arched black pulls, compact and flat
Feel: cozy, rustic, homely
Goes with: white or cream walls, black iron accents, reclaimed wood; farmhouse or rustic rooms

Type: small two-door storage cabinet
Use: storage, display surface; living room, bedroom, entryway
Style: mid-century modern, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: glossy white lacquer, walnut-tone wood legs and inset
Colors: glossy white, dark warm brown
Shape: boxy cabinet, two flat doors with curved wood finger-pull cutout between, four splayed tapered wooden legs, compact and raised
Feel: clean, light, playful
Goes with: walnut wood, white walls, muted colors; mid-century or modern rooms

Type: TV console with glass doors
Use: holding a TV and media storage; living room, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, traditional, coastal
Materials: painted wood, framed glass panel doors, brushed nickel handles
Colors: light cool grey, silver
Shape: long low case, two glass-paned side cabinets, central open shelves with cable cutout, arched apron base, medium visual weight
Feel: tidy, calm, classic
Goes with: white or grey walls, light wood floors, soft blues; farmhouse, coastal or traditional living rooms

Type: two-door accent cabinet
Use: storage, bar or display surface; living room, dining room, entryway
Style: contemporary, rustic, modern
Materials: wire-brushed wood veneer in chevron pattern, dark metal bar handles
Colors: light cool grey wood, dark gunmetal
Shape: square case, two doors with chevron grain, slim vertical handles, short tapered block legs, compact and solid
Feel: calm, textured, refined
Goes with: grey or white walls, black metal, linen textiles; modern farmhouse or contemporary rooms

Type: slatted storage cabinet with drawer
Use: storage, sideboard surface; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: rustic, traditional, Japandi
Materials: solid wood in a warm stained finish, vertical slatted fronts
Colors: warm medium brown wood
Shape: boxy case, top drawer over two slatted doors, cutout finger pulls, short tapered feet, medium size, solid
Feel: warm, natural, crafted
Goes with: cream walls, woven textures, green plants; rustic, Japandi or traditional rooms

Type: standing jewelry armoire
Use: storing jewelry and accessories; bedroom, dressing area
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: black lacquered wood, carved columns, metal knobs
Colors: glossy black, silver
Shape: tall narrow cabinet, many shallow drawers with round knobs, bowed front, turned side columns, molded top and plinth base, upright
Feel: elegant, formal, dramatic
Goes with: dark wood, white or deep walls, silver accents; traditional or classic bedrooms

Type: tall storage cabinet
Use: storing linens, books and supplies; living room, dining room, home office
Style: farmhouse, coastal, traditional
Materials: white painted wood, beadboard panel doors, brushed nickel knobs and cup pulls
Colors: white, silver
Shape: tall two-section cupboard, double doors top and bottom, middle drawer, plinth base, molded top, large but bright
Feel: fresh, tidy, homely
Goes with: beige or soft walls, wicker baskets, natural wood floors; farmhouse or coastal rooms

Type: two-drawer nightstand
Use: bedside storage; bedroom, living room
Style: rustic, traditional, Japandi
Materials: solid wood in a warm stained finish, vertical slatted drawer fronts
Colors: warm medium brown wood
Shape: boxy case, two framed slatted drawers with cutout pulls, short tapered feet, compact and solid
Feel: warm, natural, cozy
Goes with: cream linen, woven textures, warm lighting; rustic, Japandi or traditional bedrooms

Type: two-door bar cabinet
Use: storing drinks and dishes, sideboard surface; dining room, living room
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: pine wood, brushed metal pulls and leg caps
Colors: warm honey wood, silver
Shape: tall rectangular case, two flat doors with tab pulls, open frame base with stretchers and metal-capped legs, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, simple, clean
Goes with: white walls, light textiles, black or brass accents; mid-century or Scandinavian rooms
